title: What landscapers do
d: Landscapers design, install, and maintain outdoor spaces: lawns, plantings, hardscapes, irrigation, and lighting. Maintenance routes provide steady recurring re
description: Landscapers design, install, and maintain outdoor spaces: lawns, plantings, hardscapes, irrigation, and lighting. Maintenance routes provide steady recurring revenue; design-build projects provide the big tickets.

title: Essential tools
d: Commercial mower, string trimmer, edger, blower, hedge trimmer, pruning shears and loppers, shovels and rakes, wheelbarrow, and a reliable trailer. Pros add: ae
description: Commercial mower, string trimmer, edger, blower, hedge trimmer, pruning shears and loppers, shovels and rakes, wheelbarrow, and a reliable trailer. Pros add: aerator, dethatcher, bed edger, and irrigation tools.

title: Key skills
d: Plant knowledge: what thrives where. Mowing patterns and striping. Pruning correctly (the 3-cut method for limbs). Irrigation troubleshooting. Hardscape basics:
description: Plant knowledge: what thrives where. Mowing patterns and striping. Pruning correctly (the 3-cut method for limbs). Irrigation troubleshooting. Hardscape basics: pavers and retaining walls. Customer communication and route efficiency.

title: Safety essentials
d: Hearing and eye protection with power equipment. Heat illness: water, shade, pace. Call 811 before any digging. Pesticide labels are the law — get licensed for
description: Hearing and eye protection with power equipment. Heat illness: water, shade, pace. Call 811 before any digging. Pesticide labels are the law — get licensed for applications. Trailer loading and tie-down.

title: Getting started
d: Start with a mower and a truck; maintenance routes fund growth. Learn plants from local nurseries and extension services. Get licensed for pesticides and irriga
description: Start with a mower and a truck; maintenance routes fund growth. Learn plants from local nurseries and extension services. Get licensed for pesticides and irrigation where required. Reviews and photos build the route.

title: Pro tips
d: Route density beats route size — cluster customers. Upsell mulch, pruning, and cleanups to mowing clients. Mow high (3.5-4 inches) for healthier lawns. Bill rel
description: Route density beats route size — cluster customers. Upsell mulch, pruning, and cleanups to mowing clients. Mow high (3.5-4 inches) for healthier lawns. Bill reliably; late billing kills cash flow. Winter services smooth the seasons.
